header.name: Galaxy Sun V09
header.description: Galaxy Sun, increment 9: all eight planets and Halley's Comet, with their trails on from the start. The Sun drifts at helix speed (960 in per year, four Earth orbit diameters per year). Beads are drawn larger so the trails show at the default view. The galactic plane starts with its eye shut.
